today.title: Today
onb.welcome_sub: Your voice for your PC. Open apps, see your screen, help in games and homework — just by talking.
legal.note: Oswin sends your voice and, only when you ask, your screen to Google Gemini using your own key. Nothing is sent to the developer.
onb.ai_sub: Oswin talks to Google Gemini. Pick how you want to pay for it — you can change this any time.
onb.c_pro_d: Use the monthly Google Cloud credits that come with your subscription. Nothing extra to pay for AI.
onb.c_key_d: Pay Google directly for what you use — roughly $1 per hour of talking. A free tier exists outside the EU.
onb.c_cloud_d: Everything included in one subscription, no Google account needed.
onb.mic_sub: Check that Oswin hears you. Speak and watch the bar move.
onb.wake_tip: Say “Hey Oswin”, press Ctrl+Alt+J, or click the orb.
set.title: Settings
pro.f2: Apps, windows, keys and clicks on screen
pro.f5: Ask about your screen, game clips, Discord
pro.p1: Seeing your screen live + Tutor personality
pro.p2: Routines in one phrase + quiet mode
pro.p4: Control your PC from your phone (Telegram)
pro.key_ph: Paste the key from your purchase e-mail
set.autostart_window: …and show the window (otherwise quietly in the tray)
set.voice_h: A new voice starts with the next conversation.
set.custom_ph: e.g. “Call me Alex. When I ask about maths, explain step by step.”
set.custom_h: Oswin follows this in every conversation.
set.wake_h: “Hey Oswin” is recognised from short phrases by Google speech recognition. An on-device model is coming.
set.wake_threshold_h: Higher — fewer false wakes; lower — reacts more easily.
set.idle: Keep listening after a reply, s
set.vad_h: If Oswin cuts you off mid-sentence — increase it.
set.headphones: I always use headphones — interrupt by just talking
set.speaker: Speakers / headphones
set.tools_h: What Oswin may do on your computer. Switched-off abilities cannot be used.
set.confirm: Ask before shutdown, emptying the bin and “buy/delete” buttons
rt.h: A routine is a set of actions you start with one phrase. The easiest way is to say: “Hey Oswin, create a gaming routine: open Steam and Discord, volume 40, quiet mode.” Then: “start the gaming routine”.
rt.name: Name
rt.quiet_h: In quiet mode Oswin does not start talking on its own — alerts arrive as notifications. Alarms and timers still ring.
pa.on: Tell me about important things (overheating, battery, disk, long gaming)
pa.night: Gently remind me to sleep if I game after 1 am
pa.briefing: Morning briefing: weather, tasks and reminders in the first chat of the day
pa.game: Suggest a break after gaming, h
pa.game_h: 0 — never. Gaming is detected from GPU load.
gm.h: Say “watch my screen” or “follow my game” — Oswin sees your screen for the whole conversation and helps as you go: in games, code or homework (with the Tutor personality — step by step).
gm.interval_h: More often — reacts faster, but uses more of your AI quota.
gm.idle: Wait in silence in this mode, s
gm.clip_auto: Automatic: NVIDIA if its app is running, otherwise Xbox Game Bar
gm.clips_h: Turn on Instant Replay in the NVIDIA app, or background recording in Game Bar.
gm.discord_h: Set the same shortcuts in Discord → Settings → Keybinds (Toggle mute / Toggle deafen).
ph.h: Control your PC from Telegram: text or send voice messages — “what's on my screen”, “set a 20-minute timer”, “shut down the PC”. Timers and alerts arrive here too.
ph.s1: Open @BotFather in Telegram, send /newbot and choose a name.
ph.s2: Copy the token (looks like 123456:ABC…), paste it below, switch the bot on and save.
ph.s3: Open your bot and send it the pairing code that appears here.
ph.token_ph: Paste the token (the saved one is hidden)
ap.h1: Oswin finds apps from the Start menu by itself
ap.h2: If it can't find something, add your own name and a path to an .exe, shortcut, folder or website.
ap.test: Check what opens for a name
mem.title: What Oswin remembers about you
mem.add_ph: Add a fact, e.g. “classes on Tuesdays at 8”
ai.key_ph: Paste a new key (the saved one is hidden)
ai.auto_h: “Auto” — Oswin picks the best available model and switches if one is overloaded.
ai.privacy: Your voice, screen frames and messages go straight from your PC to Google Gemini under your own key. Oswin has no servers and does not see your data.
up.safe: Your settings, keys and memory are never touched. A copy of the old version is kept, and if the new one fails to start, Oswin rolls back by itself.

state.nokey_h: Open the setup assistant to add a Gemini key
empty.memory: Nothing yet. Say “remember that I have classes on Tuesdays”
empty.routines: No routines yet. Say “create a study routine: close Steam, open Teams, quiet mode for 2 hours”
sd.shutdown: Shutting down the computer in {s} s
hk.info: Click the field and press a shortcut (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+J).
hk.busy: ⚠ This shortcut is taken by another app — choose another.
hk.need_mod: Use at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.
key.none: No key yet — Oswin cannot talk.
apps.notfound: → not found. Add the app in the table above.
rt.need: A name and at least one step are needed

pro.free_sub: The essentials are free forever. Pro adds what's on the right.
pro.trial_sub: All Pro features are unlocked during the trial.
pro.del_q: Remove the key? Oswin will become the free version.
up.confirm:
Update Oswin to version {v}?

It restarts for about half a minute. Settings and memory are kept.
mem.clear_q: Oswin will forget every fact about you. Continue?
quit_q: Quit Oswin completely (it will stop listening)?
onb.how_pro: 1. Open “Activate AI Pro credits” and join the Google Developer Program with your AI Pro account.|2. Link the monthly credits to a Cloud billing account.|3. Open Google AI Studio, press “Create API key” in that project and paste it below.
onb.how_key: 1. Open Google AI Studio and sign in with Google.|2. Press “Create API key”.|3. Copy it and paste it below. In the EU, enable billing on the project.

py.tg_help:
I'm {name} — your PC, on the line.

Just write (or send a voice message) what to do: “play music”, “battery level?”, “set a 20-minute timer”, “what's on my screen?”, “shut down the PC in an hour”, “start the gaming routine”.

Commands:
/screen — screenshot
/status — PC status
/quiet — quiet mode for an hour
/update — update {name}
/clear — forget this chat
/help — this help
py.tg_linked_msg: ✅ Linked{who}! From now on I answer only you.
py.tg_hello: Hi! To link me, send the code from {name}'s settings (Phone section).
py.tg_other: This {name} is linked to another account.
py.tg_updating: Installing version {v}, back in half a minute…
py.tg_kinds: I understand text, voice messages and photos.
